title: Sheaves of Lambda-modules on the small etale site form a Grothendieck abelian category
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $T_{\Et}$ its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], $\Lambda$ a commutative ring, $\Lambda_T$ the constant sheaf of rings with value $\Lambda$ on $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and $\Mod(T_{\Et},\Lambda)=\Mod(\Lambda_T)$ the category of sheaves of $\Lambda_T$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Then $\Mod(T_{\Et},\Lambda)$ is a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian]: it is abelian, it has all small colimits, filtered colimits in it are exact, and it has a generator, namely $\bigoplus_{U\in\mathcal S}j_{U!}\Lambda_U$, where $\mathcal S$ is a set of affine objects of $T_{\Et}$ such that every object of $T_{\Et}$ has a covering by members of $\mathcal S$, and $j_{U!}\Lambda_U$ is the extension by zero of $\Lambda_T|_U$ (Stacks 03DI), i.e. the sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] of the presheaf of $\Lambda_T$-modules $V\mapsto\bigoplus_{\varphi\in\mathrm{Mor}_{T_{\Et}}(V,U)}\Lambda_T(V)$. In particular (case $\Lambda=\mathbf Z$) the category $\Ab(T_{\Et})$ of abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] is Grothendieck abelian.

source.place: Modules on Sites, Lemma 03DA (label lemma-abelian: Mod(O) is abelian), Lemma 03DB (label lemma-limits-colimits: all limits and colimits exist, filtered colimits are exact), Lemma 03EW (label lemma-module-quotient-flat, part (3): every O-module is a quotient of a direct sum of modules j_{U!}O_U, which gives the generator); the small etale site as a site with a set of objects: Topologies, Definitions 021A and 021B (literature/stacks-project/topologies.tex); the statement is used in Cohomology on Sites, proof of Lemma 07AC (label lemma-existence-derived-lower-shriek, literature/stacks-project/sites-cohomology.tex, line 9345: 'the category of modules on a ringed site is a Grothendieck abelian category')

proof.text: *Abelian.* Write $\mathcal O=\Lambda_T$, a sheaf of rings on $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Sheafification of presheaves of abelian groups exists on $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] (in Mathlib: HasSheafify and WEqualsLocallyBijective for T.smallEtaleTopology, AffineEtale.lean:112,124). Hence the category $\Mod(\mathcal O)$ of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules is abelian [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-sp-abelian]: kernels are computed sectionwise and cokernels are the sheafifications of the sectionwise cokernels. By [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful] (1) the forgetful functor $\mathrm{forget}:\Mod(\mathcal O)\to\Ab(T_{\Et})$ is faithful and exact.

*Small colimits.* By [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful] (2), applied to the site $T_{\Et}$ (on which abelian sheafification exists [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]) and $\mathcal O=\Lambda_T$, every diagram $\mathcal I\to\Mod(\mathcal O)$ indexed by a small category has a colimit, the sheafification of the sectionwise colimit; by (3) of the same lemma $\mathrm{forget}$ carries it to the colimit in $\Ab(T_{\Et})$. In particular arbitrary direct sums $\bigoplus_{k\in K}\mathcal F_k$ over a set $K$ exist in $\Mod(\mathcal O)$, with coprojections $\iota_k$, and for morphisms $h_k:\mathcal F_k\to\mathcal G$ there is a unique $h:\bigoplus_k\mathcal F_k\to\mathcal G$ with $h\iota_k=h_k$.

source.place: Modules on Sites, Lemma 03DB (label lemma-limits-colimits), first statement

proof.text: *Filtered colimits are exact.* Let $\mathcal I$ be a small filtered category and $0\to\mathcal F_i\xrightarrow{a_i}\mathcal G_i\xrightarrow{b_i}\mathcal H_i\to0$ a diagram ($i\in\mathcal I$) of short exact sequences in $\Mod(\mathcal O)$. Colimits commute with cokernels in any category (both are colimits), so $\colim\mathcal F_i\to\colim\mathcal G_i\to\colim\mathcal H_i\to0$ is exact; it remains to show that $a=\colim a_i$ is a monomorphism. Apply $\mathrm{forget}$: by step 2 (part (3) of [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful]) $\mathrm{forget}(a)$ is, up to the canonical isomorphisms, the colimit in $\Ab(T_{\Et})$ of the morphisms $\mathrm{forget}(a_i)$, which are monomorphisms because $\mathrm{forget}$ is exact (step 1). Filtered colimits in $\Ab(T_{\Et})$ are exact [lem-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves-grothendieck], so $\mathrm{forget}(a)$ is a monomorphism. A faithful functor reflects monomorphisms: if $a x=a y$ then $\mathrm{forget}(a)\mathrm{forget}(x)=\mathrm{forget}(a)\mathrm{forget}(y)$, so $\mathrm{forget}(x)=\mathrm{forget}(y)$ and $x=y$. Hence $a$ is a monomorphism and $0\to\colim\mathcal F_i\to\colim\mathcal G_i\to\colim\mathcal H_i\to0$ is exact.

source.place: Modules on Sites, Lemma 03DB, proof of the final statement ('filtered colimits are exact in Ab(C) by Lemma 03CO'), written out

proof.text: *The objects $j_{U!}\Lambda_U$.* By [lem-weil-pbc-affine-etale-essentially-small-cover] choose a set $\mathcal S$ of affine objects of $T_{\Et}$ such that every object $V$ of $T_{\Et}$ has a covering $\{U_k\to V\}_{k\in K}$ with all $U_k\in\mathcal S$. For $U\in\mathcal S$ let $\mathcal O[h_U]$ be the presheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules $V\mapsto\bigoplus_{\varphi\in\mathrm{Mor}(V,U)}\mathcal O(V)$ of [lem-weil-pbc-free-yoneda-presheaf-module] and $j_{U!}\Lambda_U=\mathcal O[h_U]^\#$ its sheafification as a presheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. For every $\mathcal F\in\Mod(\mathcal O)$ we get bijections, natural in $\mathcal F$, $\mathrm{Hom}_{\Mod(\mathcal O)}(j_{U!}\Lambda_U,\mathcal F)\cong\mathrm{Hom}_{\mathrm{PMod}(\mathcal O)}(\mathcal O[h_U],\mathcal F)\cong\mathcal F(U)$: the first by the universal property of sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], the second by [lem-weil-pbc-free-yoneda-presheaf-module]. Write $h_s:j_{U!}\Lambda_U\to\mathcal F$ for the morphism attached to $s\in\mathcal F(U)$; naturality says that for $w:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ the morphism $w\circ h_s$ is attached to $w_U(s)\in\mathcal G(U)$, i.e. $w\circ h_s=h_{w_U(s)}$. Since the bijections are additive maps of groups (the sheafification bijection is a homomorphism of abelian groups, and so is $\beta\mapsto\beta_U(e_{\mathrm{id}_U})$), $h_s=0$ iff $s=0$.

source.place: Modules on Sites, Lemma 03EW (label lemma-module-quotient-flat) part (3): every O-module is a quotient of a direct sum of j_{U_i!}O_{U_i}, via the maps j_{U!}O_U -> F adjoint to sections s in F(U); here in the separator form, with U restricted to the set S

proof.text: *Conclusion.* By steps 1, 2, 3 and 5, $\Mod(T_{\Et},\Lambda)=\Mod(\Lambda_T)$ is abelian, has all small colimits, has exact filtered colimits and has the generator $G$; it is a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian]. For $\Lambda=\mathbf Z$ the category $\Ab(T_{\Et})$ is Grothendieck abelian by [lem-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves-grothendieck] (equivalently, by the above for $\Lambda=\mathbf Z$, since every abelian sheaf carries exactly one $\mathbf Z_T$-module structure and every morphism of abelian sheaves is $\mathbf Z_T$-linear, so that $\mathrm{forget}:\Mod(\mathbf Z_T)\to\Ab(T_{\Et})$ is an isomorphism of categories).

split_report.summary: Split along Stacks sites-modules 03DA (abelian), 03DB (colimits, exact filtered colimits), 03DI/03EW (generator j_{U!}O_U with Hom = F(U)), with the set of affine étale objects from Topologies 021B/04HR. Six steps. Created four nodes: lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful (unsplit: Mod(O) colimits as sheafified sectionwise colimits, forgetful functor to Ab faithful, exact, commuting with colimits; Mathlib has the pieces but not that toSheaf preserves colimits), lem-weil-pbc-free-yoneda-presheaf-module (Mathlib leaf PresheafOfModules.freeYonedaEquiv), lem-weil-pbc-affine-etale-essentially-small-cover (Mathlib leaf: AffineEtale.instEssentiallySmall + IsCoverDense), lem-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves-grothendieck (Mathlib leaf: isGrothendieckAbelian_sheaf_smallEtaleTopology with A = AddCommGrpCat). The statement's generator was made explicit: j_{U!}Λ_U for étale (not open) U → T is defined as the sheafification of V ↦ ⊕_{Mor(V,U)} Λ_T(V) (Stacks 03DI), which needs def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification (added to stmt_deps); the open-immersion nodes def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero / lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-adjunction do not apply to étale U → T and are not used; lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-free-separator is for A-valued sheaves Sh(C,J;A), not Mod(O), and is not used (the separator argument is written out for Mod(O)). Searches: loogle shows a newer Mathlib has SheafOfModules.instIsGrothendieckAbelian (small C only), absent from the pinned Mathlib.
